description: This file implements server classes for socket communication over TCP, vsock, and file descriptor duplication within the 'cuttlefish' project. It includes server startup logic, error handling, and descriptive methods.

classes.name: TcpServer
classes.description: A server class that manages TCP socket server lifecycle, including starting and describing the server.

classes.name: VsockServer
classes.description: A server class that manages vsock socket server lifecycle, including starting and describing the server.

classes.name: DupServer
classes.description: A server class that duplicates a given file descriptor and manages its lifecycle.

methods.name: TcpServer::Start
methods.description: Attempts to start a TCP server on the specified port with retries, returning a SharedFD if successful.

methods.name: TcpServer::Describe
methods.description: Returns a string description of the TCP server, including its port.

methods.name: VsockServer::Start
methods.description: Attempts to start a vsock server, retrying until successful or encountering an unrecoverable error, then returning a SharedFD.

methods.name: VsockServer::Describe
methods.description: Returns a string description of the vsock server, including its port.

methods.name: DupServer::Start
methods.description: Returns a duplicated SharedFD of the passed file descriptor if it is open.

methods.name: DupServer::Describe
methods.description: Returns a string description of the duplicated file descriptor.
